scope: Construction learning from source and images; geometry, collision, connectivity, flexible-part and motion verification deferred at user request.

studies.lesson: Compose a recognizable asymmetric ship from a central body, one long blade, two smaller wings and an offset cockpit. The dock and pilots belong to the set root, not this airframe.
Use a plate-and-brick core with Technic holes as the hub for independently oriented body, engine and wing-root assemblies.
Combine brackets for perpendicular faces, side-stud bricks for an additional fin cluster, and hinges for oblique armour around the core.
An authored cutaway of the 16 core placements exposes four 44728 brackets in opposing pairs and one 2436a bracket. This is a visibility selection, not a source construction step.
A nine-piece visibility selection shows two 52107 side-stud bricks, a tiled face and four fins. Branching attachment faces turn a small stack into a multi-sided detail.
A narrow local plate stack carries three Technic pins and four locking hinge fingers. It becomes a transverse wing-root module when its parent rotates it.
Technic axle connectors and round axlehole plates carry two opposing System skins. Curved bricks shape the visible shell around a different internal attachment system.
Build a thin wing in a convenient local plane, strengthen its root and concentrate the long projecting detail at the tip. The parent supplies its sideways orientation.
Use dedicated left/right wedge plates and curved wedges for the long blade's tapered silhouette, with localized root reinforcement.
Make the opposite wing from actual opposite-hand pieces and its own source placements. It is a separate assembly, not a reflected copy of Wing 1.
Repeat a round-brick and translucent-dish nozzle on Technic axle-pin supports. Four nozzles form a two-by-two cluster; distinguish this visible construction from the central mechanism.
Give the offset cockpit a dedicated plate-bonded support arm with Technic interfaces and a tapered exterior.

Build the cockpit as its own local tub around the 30384 transparent windscreen, controls and axle core; use a bracket to turn the rear dome sideways. The whole pod has an independent parent orientation.
